_note: Provenance of r41cal/make_config.py's keys: image (device description or profile), derived (RTL structure), testbench, model (control). Evidence with file:line: the R41 structure inventory of 2026-11-08. Keys not listed keep the base file's value.

_not_expressible.LSU_INFLIGHT: word-path units of the hybrid LSU (tl_lsu_units refuses 1 and applies to every access)
_not_expressible.HYBRID_LSU line eligibility: only aligned vector accesses inside one line take the line path; the rest take the word unit
_not_expressible.memory issue limit: one memory instruction per 3 cycles per core
_not_expressible.path-switch drain: switching between line and word paths drains the other
_not_expressible.home same-line spacing: two requests to one line at least 2 cycles apart; RQ_N 16 request buffer
_not_expressible.per-outlet testbench latency: 25 / 44 / 63 + slot jitter by lowest free slot; one hbm_latency_cycles is a mean
_not_expressible.line-engine eligibility: only aligned whole-line boxes take the line path
_not_expressible.grid admission and outlet drain: +4 per grid launch; done waits for every outlet write response

nx.source: device platform.core_count (3x1 mesh, board top NX)

outlets.source: one outlet per core (home s -> outlet s % PORTS, tnca_mem_ports.v)

outstanding.source: device uncore.AXI_OUT_N: outlet slots and the admission limit (MMIO reset)

noc_stages.source: NOC_LINK_STAGES + router stage per XY hop (router/mesh unchanged since R40)

tl_slice_to_outlet_cycles.source: home issues its memory request at accept+3 (model: accept+1) + MEM_HOME_STAGES + LINK_STAGES link stages

tl_outlet_to_slice_cycles.source: MEM_HOME_STAGES + LINK_STAGES response registers + MS_FILL latch + fill-unit start (R40 FIT 13 retired)

tl_outlet_read_issue_cycles.source: AXI_PIPELINED_ISSUE: one issue register, next line on the AR handshake

tl_outlet_write_issue_cycles.source: AXI_PIPELINED_ISSUE: a write leaves after AW and W

tl_slice_hit_occupancy.source: home pipe takes one request per cycle (tnca_home_pipe.v)

tl_slice_hit_latency.source: accept, S1 tag read, S2 decide, S3 data -> response valid at +4

tl_slice_miss_occupancy.source: S2 allocates an MSHR in one cycle

tl_slice_mreq_occupancy.source: the memory request leaves from MSHR state on its own port

tl_slice_fill_occupancy.source: separate fill unit; pairs with wake 1

tl_slice_wake_occupancy.source: one target per cycle; HOME_LINE_PIPE 2 chains MSHR fills with no gap (1 leaves one)

tl_slice_writeback_occupancy.source: victims queue in S3 (4-entry WBQ), issued before reads

tl_core_beat_bytes.source: HYBRID_LSU: 512-bit core port, one line request per line-eligible access (the model applies it to every access: stage B)

dma_line_engine.source: device TENSOR_LINE -> transfer engine LINE_ENGINE (eligibility: stage B)

dma_line_buffers.source: LSLOT_N = 2^(MTAG_W-1), the port tag width from LINE_SLOTS (inferred)

dma_queue.source: line-eligible transfer commands overlap up to CMD_N 8 (word walk: 1)

mtx_pipe_cycles.source: PIPE = OPND_REG + popcount(MAC_CUTS[4:0]) on the MAC lane, drain PIPE+1 (tnca_matrix.v)

mtx_dp_extra_latency.source: dp and plain m.mma share the MAC lane and its PIPE

mtx_dp_prefetch.source: each group step reads B before its MACs

mtx_rf_read_cycles.source: profile MTX_VRF_REG registers every matrix VRF read (2 + MTX_VRF_REG)

mtx_mac_unbuffered_cycles.source: one matrix VRF read per unbuffered MAC (2 + MTX_VRF_REG)

reduction_latency.source: integer reductions are in the late class, no X_PROD

fp_reduction_latency.source: 4 levels x (FP_LAT+1), then done -> red_pend -> W

sfu_occupancy.source: SFU pass VLEN+LAT plus the core's done -> red_pend -> writeback (author's reading 22; open)

reduction_vector_extra.source: integer reduction broadcast in the late class

dispatch_cycles.source: per-program dispatch (R40 derivation, path unchanged), DISPATCH_STAGES 2

launch_cycles.source: per program (grid admission +4 per grid launch: stage B)

hbm_latency_cycles.source: mean over outlets of LATENCY 25+19p ([25, 44, 63]) + 2 + mean slot jitter (id*11)%31 (15.0) + mean arready wait 0.45; per-outlet latency and slot identity: stage B

tl_hbm_write_latency_cycles.source: mean LATENCY + 15 + 1 + mean (id*7)%23 (11.0) + mean AW/W wait 1.08

host_launch_cycles.source: the count runs from MMIO decode to done: host time is outside it

dram_path.source: the testbench HBM has fixed latency and no banks

memory_model.source: timeline memory: the only path with line-granular ports

core_pipeline.source: core pipeline: units, freezes, park, writeback steal
